newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Analysts puzzled by Swiss financier Ebner's moves.
newsitem.headline: Analysts puzzled by Swiss financier Ebner's moves.

text.p: Swiss financier Martin Ebner has thrown the cat among the pigeons by announcing that his fund management BZ Group has boosted its stake in Winterthur Insurance, and saying that Swiss Re had also built up a stake in the insurer.

But his tight-lipped approach to what he would do with the stake -- and another big holding in Union Bank of Switzerland -- kept analysts guessing as to what he had in mind with the Winterthur investment.

"The rumour of an acquisition (by Allianz ) that has circulated for days took a fresh twist after it emerged that Swiss Re has stepped up as a major buyer," Zurich Cantonal Bank said in a stock market research note.
"The question now is, what will happen to the stake (around 18 percent) controlled by Ebner," it added. "The price fantasy about Winterthur thus increases."
Winterthur shares opened 32 Swiss francs higher, but were off 15 at 1,423 shortly after 0900 GMT.
"I have no idea what is going on. It is incredibly difficult to understand, and I don't want to fuel the speculation," said another analyst who asked not to be named.
